newsitem.title: USA: U.S. exchanges submit opposition to FASB proposal.
newsitem.headline: U.S. exchanges submit opposition to FASB proposal.

text.p: Several U.S. futures exchanges submitted comments opposing the Financial Standards Accounting Board's (FASB) proposal to abolish deferral of hedge accounting, according to a Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) press releases.

The CBOT, with the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME), the Coffee Sugar and Cocoa Exchange (CSCE) and the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX), opposed the FASB proposal. They said the FASB's approach to derivatives accounting will "discourage the use of futures and other derivatives for risk management as firms will seek to avoid the likely distortions to their financial statements," according to the CBOT's statement.
